text:
Asking rents in Mannheim stand at a median of 12.54 €/m² (2026-06), up 3.8% on the year and +21.2% over five years. That ranks Mannheim #15 of 37 cities; new lets are priced 50% above the 2022 average contract rent of 8.39 €/m².

A 60 m² flat costs about 752 € a month in cold rent, 16.8% of the disposable income of two residents. Listings stay online for about 28 days and 27% are gone within a week; with 1.8% market-active vacancy and +2.4% population growth over five years, the market looks broadly balanced.

The model estimate for twelve months ahead is 13.08 €/m² (+4.3%), with an 80% range of 12.76 to 13.44 €/m²; housing-loan rates are at 4.01%.
